QUARANTINE AND ACQUISITION
Root alone acquires the exact eight saved catalogue URLs once each ordinary anonymous GET200, no redirect/retry. Actors do not fetch or refetch images. Each assigned card has P/sources/pc_hcp_N_pic.JPG and pc_hcp_N_adr.JPG plus P/sources/sourceN.json and addressN.json. Never read other source actors' files, later competing readings, previous target or neighbouring-card prose, saved plaintext, sender/identity leads, addenda/PDFs, parent publication receipts or historical target reports. No broad discovery/search of the private tree. Only exact assigned originals/metadata, this protocol, own files and specifically released generic helper/code inputs are allowed. No decoded/editorial Czech or English, word-based source repairs or identity/date/chronology inference during source phases. Ordinary address/person/postal/date-like writing and printed captions must not supply encoded glyph values or be transcribed as message evidence.

PHASE1 BEFORE ANY IMAGERY

Then inspect BOTH COMPLETE ORIGINAL FACES and ALL MARGINS of BOTH assigned cards, not merely a crop. Save P/readers/PAIR-face-boundary.json with actual image/metadata identities, whole original metadata objects, full-frame boxes, actual display group/timing scope and bounded source observations. State any continuous encoded regions, spatially separate regions/orientations and ordinary excluded areas without ciphertext, decoded text or translations. Do not assume Picture or Address selection from older batches. Shared image-display events are allowed when honestly recorded; no fabricated individual timestamps.
